title: Redirecting from async layout with parent suspense does not respect basePath

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/jjantschulev/nextjs-bug-redirect-from-async-layout-suspense

### To Reproduce

1. start the dev server (`pnpm dev`)
2. Visit `http://localhost:3000/base/bad`


### Current vs. Expected behavior

Next will redirect to `http://localhost:3000/good` instead of `http://localhost:3000/base/good`

I have set the `basePath` in the next config to `/base`. 

I expect that all redirect i make using the nextjs `redirect()` function from `"next/navigation"` apply the basePath automatically.

From what i can see in the browser it seems like there is an initial redirect which redirects correctly using the basePath, but then there is another redirect that refreshes the whole page, which does not include the base path.
